barOfTheWeek.blurb: Post Malone's Posty's at 305 Broadway has three stages, a dining room, and a rooftop. Joe Barron plays here Friday, Nov 20, 6 to 10 PM.
barOfTheWeek.history: Posty's opened in early July 2025 at 305 Broadway, in a partnership between Post Malone and TC Restaurant Group. The venue is about 26,000 square feet, with six bars, three stages, a full-service dining room, and a rooftop. The operator bills the main floor as the largest ground-floor footprint on Broadway.

bandSpotlight.name: Joe Barron
bandSpotlight.story: Joe Barron is from El Paso, Texas, and moved to Nashville in 2016. His site says he first played guitar at 8, later opened for Thompson Square, Parmalee, and Randy Rogers Band, and has had residencies at the Jason Aldean, Luke Bryan, and Florida Georgia Line venues downtown. His singles include Chainsmoking, which reached Spotify's New Music Nashville playlist, and Dirt Road Dance.
